newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH STATE BUDGET IN CZK 48 MLN JAN-SEPT SURPLUS.
newsitem.headline: CZECH STATE BUDGET IN CZK 48 MLN JAN-SEPT SURPLUS.

text.p: The 1996 Czech state budget showed a 48 million crown surplus through the first nine months of the year, Finance Ministry spokeswoman Ludmila Nutilova told Reuters on Tuesday.
She said revenues for the January through September period totalled 347.392 billion crowns, while expenditures were 347.344 billion crowns.
STATE BUDGET JAN-SEPT 96 H1 1996 FY 1995 JAN-SEPT 95
Note. The Czech government last month agreed to make cuts
of 9.3 billion crowns in forecast spending for the remainder of
1996 in order to bring the budget into balance.
